patches.game: Cardcaptor Sakura: Sakura to Fushigi na Clow Card
patches.notes:
**Cardcaptor Sakura: Sakura to Fushigi na Clow Card** (カードキャプターさくら さくらとふしぎなクロウカード) is a game from Bandai, released in Japan in 1999 for the original (monochrome) WonderSwan. It follows the first anime season, with Sakura in grade 4, and wraps it in a weekly life sim: each week you plan lessons and activities with Kero, go out to visit friends, shop, help at home or write the diary, and raise your friends' affinity. The story walks through the Clow Cards in roughly the order of the anime, up to Earthy, Yue and the Final Judgment, and the cards are caught in turn-based battles. There is also a link-cable deck mode.

This patch translates it into English.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **with AI** (Claude), as a hobby project. A person (me) made every judgement call before release, but nobody on the project is a professional translator. I'm sharing it as it is for anyone who wants to play. Please **don't upload it to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like). It may not be up to the standard of a real fan translation and it doesn't belong there.

**What's translated**

* **Story:** all 6,915 story texts, including the Hoe? and Hanyaan catchphrases and the Clow Card chants.
* **Menus and messages:** all menus, the weekly planner, shop and weekly results, battle messages and card descriptions, and Kero's data screens.
* **Pictures that contain text:** the title subtitle and start prompt, date cards, profile cards, weekend menu icons, battle command labels …

patches.game: Cardcaptor Sakura: Sakura to Fushigi na Clow Card
patches.notes:
**Cardcaptor Sakura - Sakura to Fushigi na Clow Card** ("Sakura and the Mysterious Clow Cards") is Bandai's 1999 Cardcaptor Sakura game for the WonderSwan, released only in Japan. It follows the first season of the anime: Sakura Kinomoto opens a strange book in her father's study, the Clow Cards scatter all over Tomoeda, and Kero, the Beast of the Seal, makes her a Cardcaptor. Week after week you plan Sakura's days, spend Sundays with her friends and family, and capture the Clow Cards in battles where the cards themselves are your weapons.

Here is the game in **Spanish from Spain**, in two versions with the same text: black and white (WonderSwan and WonderSwan Color) and Color (in colour on the WonderSwan Color). English version will be done by Hilltop Works.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **only with AI**, as a personal project. I'm sharing it as it is for personal use, but it must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like): it isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and it doesn't belong there.

****Download:** HERE**

**How it was made (double AI check)**

1. Claude translated the whole game from the Japanese.
2. ChatGPT reviewed all 9,042 lines against the Japanese and flagged doubtful lines and open choices.
3. Claude checked ChatGPT's review again line by line before applying it (some proposals were rewritten or shortened to fit the screen), and the open choices (terms and names) were decided by me, waiting for a …
